observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a DuraVolt Solar Rechargeable Pack.
The brand 'DuraVolt' is printed at the top of the box.
The model 'SRP-1245' and '12" DC FAN' are printed near the bottom left.
The box lists included items: LED bulbs, solar panel, DC cables, handle, AC/DC adapter, and a 12-inch DC fan.
The box appears to be wrapped in a thin plastic film.
The actual physical components (fan, panel, battery unit) are not shown outside the packaging.

identity.kind: Solar rechargeable pack with 12" DC fan

claims.claim: DuraVolt Solar Rechargeable Pack with 12" DC Fan (model SRP-1245)
claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly printed on the box in photo 0.
The box graphics suggest a complete system, but the actual components are not visible.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain unrelated items.
risks.proof: A photo of all components laid out outside of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty box or parts only

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or have significantly reduced capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running at full speed powered only by the battery unit.
risks.if_unproven: as having a dead battery requiring replacement

risks.risk: The solar panel may be cracked or non-functional.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the solar panel's glass surface.

risks.risk: The fan motor or control electronics may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan operating through all speed settings.

proof_requests: Photo of all items (fan, solar panel, battery unit, bulbs, and cables) outside the box.
Video of the fan running on battery power to confirm battery and motor health.
Close-up photo of the solar panel surface to check for cracks.
Photo of the rating plate on the actual battery unit to confirm the model matches the box.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified on the packaging, which allows for a valuation based on the worst-case scenario of a non-functional or incomplete unit.
